title: From Dueling Bandits to Episodic MDPs: Learning with Adversarial Preference Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2507.11706v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In dueling bandits, the learner compares two arms in each round and observes only which one is preferred. This paper asks what changes when the compared pair also affects the next state, as in a recommendation interface where the pair shown to a user affects the user's next context. We formulate this problem as a state-wise preference-based MDP, an episodic tabular MDP in which the learner selects a pair of arms at each visited state, observes only a noisy comparison between them, and moves to a next state that may depend on the pair. The preferences may change adversarially across episodes, and the loss of a pair is defined through Borda scores. translated_title: 从决斗老虎机到情景马尔可夫决策过程：对抗性偏好反馈下的学习
translated_abstract: 在决斗老虎机问题中，学习者在每一轮比较两个臂（选项），并且只能观察到哪一个更受偏好。本文探讨当被比较的选项对还会影响下一个状态时问题会发生什么变化，例如在推荐界面中，展示给用户的选项对会影响用户的下一个情境。我们将该问题形式化为一个基于状态的偏好MDP（马尔可夫决策过程），即一个情景式的表格型MDP，其中学习者在每个访问的状态选择一对臂，只观察到两者之间带有噪声的比较结果，并转移到可能依赖于该选项对的下一个状态。偏好可能在不同的情景之间以对抗方式变化，选项对的损失通过Borda分数定义。我们证明了在转移概率已知的情况下，该问题的极小极大遗憾为 $\tilde{\Theta}(\min\{HT,(H^3SK)^{1/3}T^{2/3}\})$，其中 $H$、$S$、$K$ 和 $T$ 分别是每个情景的步数、状态数、臂数和情景数，并且该速率可以通过基于在线学习的算法达到。
tldr: 本文将决斗老虎机扩展到偏好反馈会影响状态转移的情景MDP设定，在对抗性偏好变化下建立了极小极大遗憾界 $\tilde{\Theta}(\min\{HT,(H^3SK)^{1/3}T^{2/3}\})$，并给出了达到该界的算法。
en_tdlr: This paper extends dueling bandits to episodic MDPs where the compared pair influences state transitions, establishing a minimax regret of $\tilde{\Theta}(\min\{HT,(H^3SK)^{1/3}T^{2/3}\})$ under adversarial preference shifts with a matching algorithm.
